frequency_question: How often does the federal administrative apparatus successfully execute all mandatory review, notice, publication, and customs systems updates for a major tariff category within 43 days or less?
membership_rule: Includes executive orders or emergency tariff proclamations requiring custom automated commercial environment (ACE) programming and interagency review; excludes routine tariff adjustments that bypass interagency regulatory review.
coverage_note: 4 named key historical precedents for unilateral tariff implementations under executive authority with short windows.
known_gaps: Excludes minor adjustments and focuses solely on high-salience automotive or broad import categories.
skeleton: Presidential emergency declarations using Section 301 or International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) mechanisms combined with CBP system updates
multiplier: 4 historical instances of major tariff threat/implementation actions under compressed timelines, yielding 3 hits for actual execution within tight windows.
validity_reason: Statutory authorities governing emergency tariffs (IEEPA, Section 301, Section 232) and Customs and Border Protection operational procedures remain stable across this horizon.
